blocks.text: **Default type parameters and inference** — Default type parameters and inference is compile-time type manipulation — erased at run time but essential for safe APIs.. blocks.text: Production bugs involving **Default type parameters and inference** rarely look like syntax errors — they show up as wrong data, memory growth, flaky tests, or CI type failures.
